bugs.title: Arena cannot start a second match
bugs.problem: After one match ends, the same arena cannot start again, blocking the next round for players.
bugs.expected: The arena returns to an available state after match cleanup.
bugs.observed: The previous session remains active and the next match does not start.
reproduction: Return both players to the lobby.
Confirm the new match does not start.
bugs.aiAnalysis: Match cleanup leaves arena session ownership active after the round ends.

relevantCode.reason: Owns arena session cleanup and availability state.

bugs.suggestedFix: Clear arena session ownership during match cleanup so the arena becomes available for the next round.
mustPreserve: Players from another active arena must remain unaffected.

bugs.title: Match loadout drops when the player dies
bugs.problem: Match-owned loadout items drop into the world on death, allowing equipment to be lost or collected by other players.
bugs.expected: Match-owned loadout items are restored through the intended respawn flow without becoming world drops.
bugs.observed: Loadout items appear as world drops at the death location.
reproduction: Start a match and receive the normal player loadout.
Let the player die during the active match.
Return to the death location after respawn.
Confirm the loadout items are present as world drops.
bugs.aiAnalysis: The death path allows match-owned inventory to enter the normal item-drop flow before respawn restoration.

relevantCode.reason: Owns match inventory reset and restore behavior.

bugs.suggestedFix: Prevent match-owned loadout items from entering the world-drop path and restore them through the respawn flow.
mustPreserve: Normal non-match item drops must keep their existing behavior.

bugs.title: Join feedback remains visible after leaving the pad
bugs.problem: The join prompt remains visible after the player leaves the join pad, creating misleading lobby feedback.
bugs.expected: The join prompt disappears when the player leaves the join pad.
bugs.observed: The prompt remains visible outside the join pad.
reproduction: Walk onto the join pad until the join prompt appears.
Walk away from the join pad.
Confirm the join prompt remains visible outside the pad.
bugs.aiAnalysis: The leave path does not clear the player-facing join feedback state.

relevantCode.reason: Owns join-pad enter and leave feedback.

bugs.suggestedFix: Clear the join feedback state when the player leaves the join pad so the prompt disappears immediately.
